model_name: Car Damage Photo Integrity Detector v9 (localization-first)

architecture.encoder: ConvNeXt-Tiny, timm 'convnext_tiny.fb_in22k', features_only (strides 4/8/16/32; channels 96/192/384/768); ImageNet-22k init
architecture.noise_stream: fixed SRM high-pass filters (9 ch, input*255, clamp +-3, /3) + learnable 5x5 conv (6 ch); conv stages at strides 2/4/8/16 (48/64/96/128 ch)
architecture.decoder: FPN/U-Net: 1x1 laterals to 128 ch, fused with noise features at strides 16/8/4/2
architecture.head: 1x1 conv -> 1-channel edit logit map at stride 2

input.format: RGB, float in [0,1] (uint8/255); ImageNet mean/std normalisation is applied inside the model for the encoder only
input.resolution: full resolution, single pass (no tiling, no resizing); reflect-pad right/bottom to a multiple of 32, then crop the logit map back to ceil(H/2) x ceil(W/2)

scoring.rule: image score = mean of the 256 largest stride-2 logits of the edit map (about 1,024 full-res pixels); flagged iff score >= threshold
scoring.heatmap: sigmoid(logits) upsampled bilinearly to the input size

thresholds.protocol: true 2% false-alarm rate on the 600 real eval photos (CarDD val/test), set separately for each condition: threshold = 12th-highest real score

jpeg_q90.condition: every photo re-saved as JPEG quality 90 before scoring

upload.condition: resized to max side 1600 px, then JPEG quality 85

native.condition: files scored as-is; NOT a fair comparison (edited and real eval photos had different file formats), use jpeg_q90 or upload

training.optimizer: AdamW (encoder lr 1e-4, rest 4e-4, weight_decay 0.02), 600-step warmup + cosine
training.loss: pixel BCE (pos_weight 3) + Dice on the stride-2 map + 0.5 * image BCE on the top-256 score
training.data: CarDD train-split photos with SD1.5 / SDXL / Kandinsky 2.2 / LaMa inpaints (exact pixel masks), synthetic tiny paste-back edits, and genuine photos; JPEG/blur/resize augmentation applied to reals and fakes alike
training.selection: best of (TPR@2%FPR + 0.01*AUROC) on a held-out CarDD-train validation split

limitations: Not yet at 90% catch at 2% false alarms.
Small edits (0.5-3% of the photo) are the weakest case: 67.8% (JPEG q90) / 61.3% (upload).
Fully AI-generated (text-to-image) scenes: 45% (JPEG q90) / 41% (upload); v7 is much better there (98-99%).
Triage signal for human review, not proof of editing or fraud.
